title: Geologic map of the Wampee Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: W.R. Doar, III, 2015, Geologic map of the Wampee Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 215, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the text layer interleaves the map and two to three description columns on the same lines, so quotes are short single-line fragments. Units listed under an alloformation heading (barrier, estuarine and strand deposits) are associated with it from the layout and flagged inferred. Corrected text-layer characters ('|' for 1, 'istand', 'oPpas', 'Pm') are flagged inferred with notes. Most map symbols are garbled or detached from their descriptions and were not recorded (only Qe, QHsm, and inferred QPpas, QPpm). Bodies of water and disturbed ground were not recorded as units. Drill-hole labels on the map have no stated locations and the cross section is not readable; both skipped. The Waccamaw Formation text also names Mercenaria campechiensis and Glycimeris americana from J.R. DuBar's drilling logs (OCR garbled). The sheet states its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
